subject: Leadership briefing: Clarion Health discovery — outcomes, risks, procurement path
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Rao <anika.rao@clarionhealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@clarionhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: Leadership briefing & action grid from today’s discovery

Hi Anika / Samir —

Thanks again for the time today. As promised, a concise leadership-facing recap of the decisions, priorities, and the procurement path we discussed so your team can share internally. I captured the outcomes, the immediate risks you flagged, and the proposed next steps for procurement and legal. Please confirm anything I missed.

Summary 
- Business outcomes Clarion wants: reduce inference cost per query by ~35–45% while maintaining quality; move 99th percentile latency to <300ms for the clinician-facing triage flow; ensure PHI is never persisted outside your VPC.
- Top pain points observed: inconsistent tail latency during peak batch hours (overnight triage), high per-token costs on long patient narratives, and procurement/legal needing SOC 2 + documented data flow for embedded workloads.
- Shortlist items for execs: cost-savings estimate (model + quant + batching) — baseline vs expected; SLA targets and escalation ladder; timeline for private deployment vs dedicated capacity (impact on procurement).

Risks called out by Clarion (from today’s call)
1) Security evidence: procurement needs SOC 2 report and an architecture diagram that shows KMS/HSM integrations.
2) Data residency: strict requirement for all PHI processing to occur in the Clarion VPC (private deployment) or a covered region with enforced egress controls.
3) Schedule risk: procurement timeline pushes decision to week of 2027-01-18 unless we can surface a draft SOW and pricing this week.

Proposed procurement path (recommended)
- This week: Redwood to provide (1) trimmed risk assessment doc, (2) draft SOW with indicative pricing, (3) SOC 2 pointer and control summary. (Attachments: Clarion_Risk_Assessment.pdf, Redwood_Draft_SOW_Clarion.docx)
- Next week: Clarion legal & procurement to review SOW; Redwood to schedule security review with Samir + one of our security engineers.
- Week of 2027-01-11: target for commercial approval and initial PO/commit.

Immediate asks / owners
- Action: Evelyn to deliver risk assessment + draft SOW by EOD tomorrow. (owner: Evelyn)
- Action: Samir to share any mandatory vendor questionnaire or minimum-security-checklist. (owner: Samir)
- Action: Ben to confirm commercial flexibility (discount band and pilot terms). (owner: Ben)

If that matches, I’ll convert this into a one-page exec summary for your CFO and drop the attachments to DocuSign-ready format so procurement can route internally.

Regards,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[e] evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | [m] +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Clarion_Risk_Assessment.pdf (pdf, 145KB); Redwood_Draft_SOW_Clarion.docx (docx, 90KB)
From: Anika Rao <anika.rao@clarionhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@clarionhealth.com>
Cc: procurement@clarionhealth.com
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 17:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Leadership briefing & action grid from today’s discovery

Evelyn —

Thanks for the clear note. This captures it well. A couple clarifications from our side:

- Procurement timeline: we have a procurement gate on 2027-01-20 (CFO review). To make that window we need contract language and SOW in the next two weeks.
- Security: please include a short control-mapping (SOC 2 controls → Clarion controls) and the network diagram showing data flow for the embeddings/semantic search path. We also need confirmation that no PHI is logged or stored outside an approved VPC.
- Commercial ask: we’d like a 3-month pilot with a capped monthly spend and a conversion-to-reserved-capacity credit if metrics are hit.

Samir — I’ll drop our vendor questionnaire to procurement this afternoon; Evelyn, copying procurement so you have the intake path.

Best,
Anika Rao
VP Product, Clarion Health
[ph] +1 (617) 555-0083
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anika Rao <anika.rao@clarionhealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@clarionhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Leadership briefing & action grid from today’s discovery

Evelyn / team —

Quick commercial note: we can support a 3-month pilot with a spend cap and an optional conversion credit toward Dedicated/Private committed capacity. I’ll need to align the exact credit math, but ballpark: 50% of pilot spend applied as a one-time credit toward a 12-month Reserved Capacity commitment if the 99th percentile latency and cost targets are met.

On the contract lane: Legal is comfortable with an expedited SOW + Master Services Agreement redline cycle if Clarion can provide procurement’s standard terms early. I’ll own the discount / credit structure and get you an indicative term sheet today.

Marissa — can you prep a short success metrics doc (pilot acceptance criteria + monitoring hooks: latency dashboards, token cost report, QA prompts) so procurement has an objective conversion gate?

Ben Carter
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Rao <anika.rao@clarionhealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@clarionhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@clarionhealth.com
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 11:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Leadership briefing & action grid from today’s discovery

Thanks all —

Next steps I’ll execute today:
- Send the trimmed risk assessment and draft SOW to procurement (attached). [Attachment: Clarion_Risk_Assessment.pdf; Redwood_Draft_SOW_Clarion.docx]
- Schedule a 60-minute security review with Samir + one of our security engineers (proposed: Mon 2026-12-07 10:00 PT).
- Upload the pilot success criteria doc (Marissa) to the HubSpot deal and share the link to procurement.
- Ben to share indicative term sheet and conversion credit details by EOD.

If procurement needs a DocuSign-ready SOW, I’ll convert and share the docusign link to procurement@clarionhealth.com and to you, Anika.

I’ll follow up with the calendar invite and the HubSpot record link once items are posted.

Best,
Evelyn
